content: STAAD.Pro hard model limits: 400,000 joints, 500,000 members/plates/solids, 10,101 load cases, member numbers to 999,999. Bentley practical guidance: keep models within ~20,000 members/plates for usability. Typical scale: small frames 50-500 members, buildings 500-10k, large industrial/plants/offshore 10k-100k+. .std is plain text; industrial decks commonly 10-60+ MB (PITFALLS research), 100k members roughly 10-30 MB. UX implications: worker-based parse with progress, file-size guard at pick time, streaming blob reads (never base64), instanced rendering with per-instance culling/LOD, camera fit to bounds, parse-time counts for summary.
